module_api.Rig(actor, era): loads the GrabCut pieces + rig.json; .world(pose) FK matrices, .render(pose, A_stage_to_canvas, size, lum, pieces_alpha) -> rgb, alpha, piece_alpha, landmarks (canvas), .bone_lengths(pose)
module_api.POSES / HOP_KEYS / HOP_ARRIVE: pose library: rest, crouch, push, air, land, settle, hold, plus strike, recoil, cock, peck, look_up (additive head offsets)
module_api.track_climb(rig, treads, f0, frames): hop cycle, one tread per 8 frames, on twos (crouch f0, push f2, air f4, land f6); settle/hold on arrival; feet planted by ground_pose
module_api.head_score(f, e3, e4) / peck_score(f, f_: the strike: head world -22 deg about the neck pin over 2 frames (neck -15, head -7), recoil to +6 over 2 frames, on ones; peck_score = the single-strike counterexample (V3 at 4.6 s)
module_api.track_step_over(rig, x0, y_landing, x_si: step over the sill: near foot lifts (hip +40, shank -70), then the far foot, then walks into the hall
module_api.tail_lag(track, rig): tail as a lagged child, 2 frames behind the body rotation
module_api.plant_both / ground_pose: root motion consistent with contact: the soles are put on a ground(x) function
module_api.cast_shadow(alpha, ground_y, light, rise: hard cast shadow sheared by light direction, broken (stepped) at each riser line
module_api.Watcher(): .score(t, x0, x_stop): slide, stop at 3.5 s with a 0.4 s ease, head +14 deg on twos (>=12), held to 10.0, resumes at 11.0; .shadow(t, foot, A, size, height_stage, x0, x_stop, light): body+head silhouette projected onto the ground plane (long low-sun shadow via the light vector)
module_api.hinge_quad / hand_theta: 1959: hinge homography of the leaf quad, latch at 6.75, unseen-hand swing to 78 deg over E5 7.0-8.5
module_api.chain_theta / chain_links: 2009: hinged swing stopping at 25 deg on the chain with a damped bounce; 6-link catenary that goes taut at the stop (handmade chain geometry)
module_api.DoorFSM(strikes, t_close).trace(t_end) /: 2059 #48 state table closed -> listening -> open | refuse with 7 sensor-dot states per frame and the self-slide offset
module_api.save_track / load_track: tracks/<shot>.json per-frame root, rot, scale, joint angles

produced.editor_usage: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '<puppet dir>'); import puppet as P; bird = P.Rig('rooster', era=1959); lay = bird.render(pose, A, (960, 540)). knockproof.py is a worked example of the full V1-B layer DAG: plate -> hall -> swung leaf -> cast shadow -> bird -> railing holdout -> jamb holdout (inside) -> vignette -> kit grain.

knock_proof.what: V1-B alone, 6.0 s (local 5.0-11.0), 960x540, 24 fps, temporary knock sound (Knock on door.wav strike, +5/+8 semitones, so strike 2 is +3 above strike 1) over the 1941 room tone. Two hops up the handrail, the perch, a close insert (clip 0.67-1.75 s) on the beak meeting the leaf for both strikes (E3 f24, E4 f32), the latch, the unseen-hand swing, the black hall, the leap off the rail into the hall and the jamb swallowing the bird by f118.

baseline.what: rigid sticker: one pose translated along the rail and into the doorway, no joints, no head strike, no insert, no cast/contact shadow, no holdout; the knock is sound only

review_fixes.bird_larger: bird 112 plate px on a 560 px wide shot B (~36% of frame height, measured from the stills) vs ~26% in test-shot.mp4; in the insert the bird is ~40-45%
review_fixes.strikes_readable: close insert on beak and leaf for both strikes; strike on ones (2 frames down, 2 frames recoil) with the body pitching 8 deg into the blow; the head's cast shadow on the leaf closes to the beak tip on the contact frames (gap 0)
review_fixes.white_balance: measured on the rendered frames: before the door opens >200 = 22-24%, <40 = 5-10%, R-B mean 0.0, corner/centre 0.44-0.49; after the door opens the black hall is the one big mass (<40 = 38-45%). Gap: the insert frames at E3/E4 have only ~6% <40 (the plan bar for the 1959 frame at E3 asks >=15%); the editor can hold shot B instead of the insert at 9.0 s for compare-1959.jpg, or accept the insert as the readability fix.

conventions.multiply_order: world(child) = world(parent) @ T(pivot_child) @ R(angle_child) @ T(-pivot_child); world(root) = T(root_xy) @ R(root_angle) @ S(scale) @ T(-pivot_root)
conventions.pivot: rig px of the pin in the piece's own (unposed) image; bone = |pivot_child - pivot_parent|

gaps: beatmap.json / plates.json were absent: V1-A, V2 and V3 tracks are not baked; the module gives the generators (track_climb, peck_score, track_step_over, Watcher, chain/slide/FSM) that need tread points, door quads and light vectors from plates.json. Only V1-B is a finished shot; v1a-climb-demo uses provisional tread points and the bird there is small (about 10% of frame height) because the demo camera is wide.
In V1-B the bird enters by a leap from the handrail perch into the hall (the approved test-shot staging), not by a step over a floor-level sill; track_step_over is provided for a landing staging.
The colour 2009/2059 bird is the toned 1870s rooster (Commons 429).
The watcher's shadow rig is built and scored but not composited into any rendered shot in this unit.
No independent critic has watched knock-proof.mp4; readability of the two strikes with sound off is perceptually judged by this builder only.
